children: A hacker previously behind attacks on Fetch.ai and NuNet used a SingularityNET vulnerability to mint 260 million AGIX and 53.838 million WMTX without authorization on the Ethereum network. According to Odaily, the attacker currently holds crypto assets worth about $16.77 million, including 198.3 million AGIX, 649 ETH, and 33.538 million WMTX.

title: Hacker Mints 260 Million AGIX and 53.838 Million WMTX on Ethereum After SingularityNET Exploit
